title: Hadith on Allah's Extensive Mercy
summary: A Hadith explaining Allah's mercy being divided into 100 parts, one for the world and 99 reserved for believers in the Hereafter.
translation:
In the Holy Quran, it is stated, 'Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.' Despairing is a sign of disbelief because Allah is most merciful. The Hadith explains this further: Allah created mercy in 100 parts, sending one part to the world, which includes humans, jinn, animals, and all creatures. All mutual affection and kindness in the world stem from just this one part of mercy. The love a person has for their family, the bond between teachers and students, and the admiration for those who do good are all due to this single part. The love in people's hearts for the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and Allah is a result of this same mercy.

This one portion of mercy encompasses the entire universe, yet it seems insufficient compared to the remaining 99 parts. These 99 parts are reserved by Allah for the Day of Judgment, to be showered upon the believers and righteous, those who believe in Allah and the Last Day. As a result, they will benefit immensely and be saved from hellfire, granted entry into paradise, and bestowed with Allah’s vision. Therefore, one must never despair of Allah’s mercy, regardless of their sins.

Even if a person is weary of sinning, Allah never tires of forgiving because weariness is a flaw, and Allah is free from defects. Thus, never despair, no matter how many sins have been committed—repent in solitude, weep to Allah. When one gains closeness to Allah, all worldly difficulties appear trivial, making worship and obeying Allah easier, leading to happiness in this life and the next. Relatives, parents, children, spouses, and colleagues will all be pleased with us as we fulfill our duties well.

Conversely, those who despair of Allah’s mercy feel overwhelmed, thinking they must manage everything themselves. This leads to becoming entrapped in constant misfortune and stress, sometimes even self-destruction. Thus, one should never despair of Allah’s mercy. Only those who do not believe lose hope in it. A believer, reminded of Allah’s greatness, cannot despair. We should pray, repent earnestly, and lighten our burdens of sin, asking Allah to accept our repentance and grant us abundant mercy.
